data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 53.254m. During 2016 there was a small gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 0.256m (c.0.48% of opening reserves) though net movement was adverse (GBP 1.103m) reflecting movements in reinsurers' recoveries. The 2016 accident year experienced catastrophe activity (notably Fort McMurray wildfires, Hurricane Matthew, Texas hail/flooding and the Gatlinburg wildfires) which produced several gross catastrophe losses partially offset by reinsurance, predominantly impacting the Property book. Overall the prior year reserve movement is a modest strengthening on a gross basis but net adverse after reinsurance effects.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 1.1m (2015: GBP 4.8m favourable).
The principal driver for the net loss ratio of 77.9% (2015: 58.2%) is a combination of catastrophe and risk loss activity during the current accident year.
On 1 May 2016, the Syndicate incurred catastrophe losses from the Fort McMurray Wildfires in Alberta, Canada.
The gross losses of GBP 18.1m were partially mitigated by the responsiveness of the Syndicate's outwards reinsurance program, with net losses incurred for this event of GBP 4.0m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement: gross movement of GBP 0.256m taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' gross column in Technical Provisions note. The narrative sentence in the report quotes net adverse development (GBP 1.1m) - gross vs net differ materially due to reinsurance movements. LOB-level prior-year movements in the notes are presented net; gross split by LOB is not available, so LOB amounts are null and directions are inferred from net-line disclosures. Claims development triangle (gross) is provided and used as supporting data; no RITC distortion affects the 2016 gross triangle.
